No outer-host cleanup margin exists. This is a configuration/source bound comparison, not a measured 300-second hosted failure.
additional_host_incompatibility.counterexample: The same unmodified inference source persisted completed on success and unknown after cancellation in a surviving Node 22 process. Reclaiming an invocation when the async terminal write began left the synthetic durable record running. Dispatch count stayed one. See offline fixture limitations below.

smallest_followup_and_reacceptance.why_unchanged_candidate_cannot_be_certif: A route-level disconnect flag cannot extend application-owned persistence. Leaving cancellation disabled does not demonstrate required disconnect propagation. Enabling it without host lifetime registration permits unfinished terminal writes. Equal host/application ceilings independently prevent a cleanup guarantee at maximum duration.
smallest_followup_and_reacceptance.minimal_candidate_change: A narrow Nova hosting lifecycle adapter: register a deferred terminal-lifecycle promise with Next after / host waitUntil before any dispatch; settle it on all completion, pre-admission, abort and error paths after existing terminal persistence. Expose/track that lifecycle without reclassifying outcomes, changing grants, replaying work or rewriting records. Expected affected boundary: src/app/v1/inference/route.ts and the completion contract in src/lib/nova/inference.ts.
smallest_followup_and_reacceptance.separate_target_requirement: Retain the accepted 300-second execution deadline and provide a larger host/function budget for bounded cleanup. Raising a plan limit alone does not supply the missing lifecycle registration. No purchase, deadline reduction or alternative-host migration is authorized by this stopped run.
